en: Had you seen this Cold War documentary before?
it: Avevi già visto questo documentario sulla guerra fredda?
note: Verification correction: standardized the Italian lowercase spelling of ‘guerra fredda’.

en: I wish she were more critical of Big Tech's practices.
it: Vorrei che fosse più critica nei confronti delle pratiche delle Big Tech.
note: Verification correction: added the idiomatic Italian plural article in ‘le Big Tech’.

en: By next year, they will have completed their research on the Cold War.
it: Entro l'anno prossimo avranno completato la loro ricerca sulla guerra fredda.
note: Verification correction: standardized the Italian lowercase spelling of ‘guerra fredda’.

en: If we had known about the meeting, we would have attended.
it: Se avessimo saputo della riunione, avremmo partecipato.

en: You will understand better when you have studied all the theories.
it: Capirai meglio quando avrai studiato tutte le teorie.

en: Had they told us, we would have prepared a presentation.
it: Se ce l'avessero detto, avremmo preparato una presentazione.

en: I thought she had been researching this topic for years.
it: Pensavo che lei facesse ricerche su questo argomento da anni.

en: Whenever he speaks about the Cold War, everyone listens intently.
it: Ogni volta che parla della guerra fredda, tutti lo ascoltano attentamente.
note: Verification correction: standardized the Italian lowercase spelling of ‘guerra fredda’.

en: If they had been aware, they would have protested against Big Tech's data collection.
it: Se ne fossero stati al corrente, avrebbero protestato contro la raccolta di dati da parte delle Big Tech.
note: Verification correction: added the idiomatic Italian plural article in ‘le Big Tech’.

en: By the time you arrive, the seminar will have already started.
it: Quando arriverai, il seminario sarà già iniziato.

en: If she were the professor, she would emphasize the role of neoliberalism.
it: Se fosse lei la professoressa, sottolineerebbe il ruolo del neoliberismo.

en: He wished he had met the veterans of the Cold War.
it: Avrebbe voluto aver conosciuto i veterani della guerra fredda.
note: Verification correction: standardized the Italian lowercase spelling of ‘guerra fredda’.

en: I doubt they bring their phones to the tech-free retreats.
it: Dubito che portino i cellulari ai ritiri senza tecnologia.

en: If you had warned me, I would have been more careful about sharing my data.
it: Se mi avessi avvertito, avrei condiviso i miei dati con maggiore cautela.

en: She hopes that the tech industry changes its practices.
it: Spera che l'industria tecnologica cambi le proprie pratiche.

en: Whenever we go to the tech conference, we network with industry leaders.
it: Ogni volta che andiamo alla conferenza tecnologica, facciamo rete con i leader del settore.

en: They would have been more influential if they had written about the Cold War.
it: Sarebbero stati più influenti se avessero scritto sulla guerra fredda.
note: Verification correction: standardized the Italian lowercase spelling of ‘guerra fredda’.

en: By the time he realizes, it might be too late to critique Big Tech.
it: Quando se ne renderà conto, potrebbe essere troppo tardi per criticare le Big Tech.
note: Verification correction: added the idiomatic Italian plural article in ‘le Big Tech’.

en: He thought that she would write a book about neoliberalism.
it: Pensava che lei avrebbe scritto un libro sul neoliberismo.

en: Had I been aware, I would have attended the Cold War reunion.
it: Se lo avessi saputo, avrei partecipato al raduno dedicato alla guerra fredda.
note: “Cold War reunion” is ambiguous; rendered as a gathering devoted to the Cold War. The German ref misreads “reunion” as “reunification”. Verification correction: standardized the Italian lowercase spelling of ‘guerra fredda’.

en: I wish you were attending the tech summit next month.
it: Vorrei che partecipassi al vertice tecnologico il mese prossimo.

en: If he speaks at the event, it will draw a lot of attention.
it: Se interviene all'evento, attirerà molta attenzione.

en: You would have been famous if you had predicted the rise of Big Tech.
it: Avresti raggiunto la fama se avessi previsto l'ascesa delle Big Tech.
note: Verification correction: added the idiomatic Italian plural article in ‘le Big Tech’.

en: They hope you understand the nuances of the Cold War.
it: Sperano che tu comprenda le sfumature della guerra fredda.
note: Verification correction: standardized the Italian lowercase spelling of ‘guerra fredda’.

en: I doubted that she had been to a tech-free zone.
it: Dubitavo che fosse stata in una zona senza tecnologia.

en: Whenever she writes about neoliberalism, her articles go viral.
it: Ogni volta che scrive di neoliberismo, i suoi articoli diventano virali.

en: By next month, the report on Big Tech's influence will have been published.
it: Entro il mese prossimo, il rapporto sull'influenza delle Big Tech sarà stato pubblicato.
note: Verification correction: added the idiomatic Italian plural article in ‘le Big Tech’.

en: If they went to the Cold War sites, they would learn a lot.
it: Se visitassero i siti della guerra fredda, imparerebbero molto.
note: Verification correction: standardized the Italian lowercase spelling of ‘guerra fredda’.

en: She wished she spoke at the last tech conference.
it: Rimpiangeva di non aver preso la parola all'ultima conferenza tecnologica.
note: The English uses “spoke” where the past-regret sense calls for “had spoken”; translated according to the evident intent. Verification correction: made the unrealized past regret explicit in idiomatic Italian.

en: If I had known about the debate, I would have participated.
it: Se avessi saputo del dibattito, avrei partecipato.

en: He hopes that she reads his book on neoliberalism.
it: Lui spera che lei legga il suo libro sul neoliberismo.

en: Had you warned them, they would have been cautious.
it: Se li avessi avvertiti, sarebbero stati prudenti.

en: By the time we finish this course, we will have covered the entire history of the Cold War.
it: Quando avremo finito questo corso, avremo trattato l'intera storia della guerra fredda.
note: Verification correction: standardized the Italian lowercase spelling of ‘guerra fredda’.

en: Whenever you talk about Big Tech, ensure you have your facts right.
it: Ogni volta che parli delle Big Tech, assicurati di avere le informazioni corrette.
note: Verification correction: added the idiomatic Italian plural article in ‘le Big Tech’.

en: I doubt he goes offline for more than a day.
it: Dubito che resti offline per più di un giorno.

en: Had they been more proactive, they would have critiqued Big Tech earlier.
it: Se fossero stati più proattivi, avrebbero criticato le Big Tech prima.
note: Verification correction: added the idiomatic Italian plural article in ‘le Big Tech’.

en: If she writes her thesis on the Cold War, she will need many sources.
it: Se scrive la tesi sulla guerra fredda, avrà bisogno di molte fonti.
note: Verification correction: standardized the Italian lowercase spelling of ‘guerra fredda’.

en: They hoped he had researched neoliberal policies.
it: Speravano che avesse svolto ricerche sulle politiche neoliberiste.

en: Whenever you critique neoliberalism, make sure to cite your references.
it: Ogni volta che critichi il neoliberismo, assicurati di citare le fonti.
